title: Recent advances in potassium metal batteries: electrodes, interfaces and electrolytes
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00845F, Review Article
Open Access

Jianlu Sun, Yichen Du, Yijiang Liu, Dongbo Yan, Xiaodong Li, Dong Ha Kim, Zhiqun Lin, Xiaosi Zhou
This review explores the latest advancements in potassium metal batteries, including electrode design, interface engineering, and electrolyte optimization to suppress potassium dendrite formation and enhance cycling stability.
